<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">
<!-- Required for Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Crashlytics) and Firebase AI Logic / Gemini calls --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" /> <!-- Lets Firebase SDKs and the app detect connectivity changes (offline cart, retry logic) --> <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE" />
<application android:allowBackup="true" android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules" android:fullBackupContent="@xml/backup_rules" android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher" android:label="@string/app_name" android:roundIcon="@mipmap/ic_launcher_round" android:supportsRtl="true" android:theme="@style/Theme.FastOrder"> <activity android:name=".MainActivity" android:exported="true" android:label="@string/app_name" android:theme="@style/Theme.FastOrder.Splash" android:windowSoftInputMode="adjustResize"> <intent-filter> <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
<category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" /> </intent-filter> </activity> </application>
</manifest>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- FastOrder splash logo: a shopping bag with a lightning bolt ("fast" delivery).
Sized as a 108x108 vector with the artwork constrained to the centre ~66%, which is the safe zone the Android 12+ splash screen masks to. Anything outside that circle gets clipped on newer devices. --> <vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:width="108dp" android:height="108dp" android:viewportWidth="108" android:viewportHeight="108">
<!-- Bag handle (drawn first so the body overlaps its ends) --> <path android:fillColor="#00000000" android:pathData="M46,44 v-5 a8,8 0 0 1 16,0 v5" android:strokeColor="@color/brand_primary" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:strokeWidth="5" />
<!-- Bag body --> <path android:fillColor="@color/brand_primary" android:pathData="M35,41 h38 a3,3 0 0 1 3,3 v30 a6,6 0 0 1 -6,6 h-32 a6,6 0 0 1 -6,-6 v-30 a3,3 0 0 1 3,-3 z" />
<!-- Lightning bolt knocked out of the bag --> <path android:fillColor="@color/splash_background" android:pathData="M58,48 L47,63 L53,63 L50,76 L61,60 L55,60 Z" /> </vector>

<!-- Brand / splash palette. Deep aubergine background with a vivid amber mark - high contrast, in the spirit of Zepto's purple+yellow. Deliberately NOT white, so the launch feels branded rather than blank. Kept identical in values-night: a brand splash should not change with the system theme. --> <color name="brand_primary">#FFFFC531</color> <color name="splash_background">#FF2E0F4F</color> <color name="splash_on_background">#FFF3E9FF</color> </resources>
